data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 18.1m was experienced in 2017 (2016: GBP 8.6m deficit). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 22.5m on direct business (2016: GBP 14.1m deficit) and a GBP 4.4m deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2016: GBP 5.5m surplus).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross surplus run-off of GBP 18.1m in 2017 (a release), driven by favourable prior year claims development on direct business (gross surplus GBP 22.5m) partially offset by adverse development on reinsurance accepted business (GBP 4.4m strengthening). The net effect was a release equivalent to approximately 6.6% of opening gross claims outstanding.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development gross figure taken from narrative in Claims Outstanding note (explicitly states surplus of GBP 18.1m and component gross amounts GBP 22.5m direct / GBP 4.4m reinsurance accepted). No explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision' table with separate 'Insurance liabilities' column was present. A gross claims development triangle exists and was used for cross-checking; figures in the triangle are presented in thousands. Lob-level prior year movements are not disaggregated in the report beyond direct vs reinsurance accepted, so LOB allocations beyond those are not provided.
